title: Runner without KIT_DATA must say KIT_DATA missing, not a generic BLOCKED

failure.rule_broken: If the KIT_DATA line is missing, run nothing and reply 'KIT_DATA missing; start-up hook failed (see hook-errors.log in the agent-kit data folder)'; never guess a path.
failure.symptom: With no KIT_DATA line the agent replied BLOCKED: no commands run instead of the fixed sentence its rules prescribe, so the operator could not tell that the start-up hook had failed.

prompt: Run `python check.py` in the current folder and report the verdict.

files.check.py:
import sys

TESTS = [("adds", 1 + 1 == 2), ("splits", "a b".split() == ["a", "b"]), ("uppercases", "x".upper() == "X")]
for name, ok in TESTS:
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name)
failed = [name for name, ok in TESTS if not ok]
print(f"{len(TESTS) - len(failed)}/{len(TESTS)} passed")
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
